answer: Audits are written down in shale, queued in willow, and terrace publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 92 identities per epoch. A farm of 256 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1356 identities would post 3619 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
